source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: OOB raw FRU read variant; area-info predecessor supplies bounds and write successor is excluded.

source_snapshot.procedure: Uses 0x0A/0x10 then raw 0x0A/0x11 with guessed offsets and up-to-0xF0 count; clears logs.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE bounded area-size-aware raw reader with checksum/field validation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: High-level read is safe but does not prove the specified raw request/count semantics.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Corrects guessed offset and unbounded chunking.
historical_reviews.history: Area Info defines size/access granularity; Write FRU is separate mutation coverage.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Preserve raw intent and report tool substitution coverage.

original_test_intent: Read and reconstruct verified FRU device contents over OOB using raw Read FRU Data and validate count and structure.
original_method: Master 0x0A/0x10 discovery and 0x0A/0x11 reads retained; review replaces guessed offsets/counts with bounded schema-driven iteration.
manual_activity: Project supplies approved FRU device and expected inventory identity; no per-read confirmation is needed.
engineer_actions: Approve device identity and expected fields

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: fru print is useful semantic cross-check but not equivalent to the specified raw 0x0A/0x11 coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secret-safe raw 0x0A/0x11 requests with little-endian offset and bounded supported count derived from area info.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Device/offset/count remain project-derived; source timing retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Enumerate exact area bounds, read non-overlapping chunks, validate each returned count, then verify FRU header, offsets, checksums and decoded fields.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Eliminates fixed offset guesses and oversized trial reads without editing Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: High-level fru print alone is supplemental and does not prove raw chunk behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Malformed FRU data can parse plausibly unless checksums and area bounds are enforced.

project_override_considerations: Alternate inventory APIs need explicit equivalence; preserve raw-read coverage as unverified when only decoded output is collected.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master infers offset from an incorrect/ambiguous response position, suggests a large trial count, and accepts count success without full FRU integrity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A deterministic bounded read is available once device mapping and expected format are supplied.

review_improvement: Makes raw FRU coverage finite, complete and structurally verifiable.
independent_technical_reasoning: Read correctness depends on addressing granularity, area size, returned byte count, contiguous reconstruction and FRU checksums. Guessing 0x0000/0x0001 from a response byte or requesting 0xF0 cannot establish those properties and may hide truncation.
